note.zh-TW: 模板要求輸入負數（T07）；網站以正數顯示並標示為減項，匯出 Excel 時再轉成負數。
note.en: The template expects a negative entry (T07); the site shows a positive amount marked as a deduction and converts it when exporting to Excel.

definition.zh-TW: 期末還沒賣出去的存貨成本。因為沒賣出去，不能算進營業成本，所以在模板裡用減項呈現；它的金額和資產負債表的存貨相同。
definition.en: The cost of inventories still unsold at the period end. Because they were not sold they are excluded from cost of sales, so the template shows them as a deduction; the amount equals inventories on the statement of financial position.
